translations.zh: 子遵甫，官至北作坊副使。
translations.literal: His son Zunfu served as vice commissioner of the Northern Workshop.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zunfu served as vice commissioner of the Northern Workshop.

translations.zh: 嘉佑八年，遵甫女正位皇后，神宗即位，冊皇太后。
translations.literal: In the eighth year of Jiayou, Zunfu's daughter took the principal place as empress; when Shenzong ascended the throne, she was installed as empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Jiayou, Zunfu's daughter became empress in principal rank. When Shenzong ascended the throne, she was installed as empress dowager.

translations.zh: 累贈繼勳太師、尚書令兼中書令，追封康王，諡穆武。
translations.literal: Jixun was repeatedly posthumously honored as Grand Preceptor, Director of the Secretariat concurrent Grand Councilor, posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Kang, and given the posthumous title Muwu.
translations.idiomatic: Jixun was repeatedly posthumously honored as Grand Preceptor, Director of the Secretariat concurrent Grand Councilor, posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Kang, and given the posthumous title Muwu.

translations.zh: 熙寧九年，帝詔宰相王珪為神道碑，御篆碑首曰「克勤敏功鍾慶之碑」。
translations.literal: In the ninth year of Xining, the emperor ordered the chief councilor Wang Gui to compose a spirit-way stele; the imperial calligraphy on the stele head read: "Stele of Meritorious Diligence Bringing Accumulated Blessings."
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Xining, the emperor ordered Chief Councilor Wang Gui to compose a spirit-way stele. The imperial calligraphy on the stele head read: "Stele of Meritorious Diligence Bringing Accumulated Blessings."

translations.zh: 遵甫亦贈太師、尚書令兼中書令，追封楚王。
translations.literal: Zunfu was also posthumously honored as Grand Preceptor, Director of the Secretariat concurrent Grand Councilor, and posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: Zunfu was also posthumously honored as Grand Preceptor, Director of the Secretariat concurrent Grand Councilor, and posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Chu.
